morbi.headline: Mixed week for Morbi: Tile export projections drop while propane availability lowers input costs
what_changed: Somany Ceramics projected total tile exports to decline to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore.
Morbi ceramic units reduced PNG consumption following an improved supply of propane.
Apollo Pipes set a revenue target of Rs 1,000 crore for its ceramics business.
stress_signals: Overall tile exports projected to fall to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore [202e1481c238]
improvement_signals: Reduction in PNG consumption across ceramic units due to better propane supply availability [81469af468f3]
what_to_watch: Propane vs. PNG cost differentials and actual fuel substitution volumes in Morbi cluster.
Export order book trends and destination-specific demand slowdowns for tile exporters.
Apollo Pipes' market entry strategy and potential manufacturing partnerships or capacity setups.

surat.headline: Surat diamonds rally on Christmas export demand, while textiles face mixed inflation-led demand signals.
what_changed: Diamond processing units drastically cut Diwali breaks from 25 days down to 7 days due to rising order volumes.
Gems and jewellery exports jumped 34.01% driven by pre-Christmas demand for studded gold jewellery and polished diamonds.
Crude oil prices fell 17% in 10 days, lowering input costs for MMF textile operators.
Textile traders reopened post-Diwali on Labh Panchami amid reports of inflation weighing on retail consumer buying.
stress_signals: Rising inflation has reduced retail buying, causing a slowdown and distress among local textile traders [0fed4a76da43].
A severe fire broke out at a textile waste godown in Surat requiring nine fire tenders, indicating localized operational risk [317f5c9fd10d].
improvement_signals: Gem and jewellery exports surged 34.01% ahead of Christmas on strong demand for polished diamonds and studded gold jewellery [c3b68570a07d].
Surat diamond units reduced Diwali vacations from 25 days to 7 days due to improved order flow [20dc10f35062, 5fc0b7b85616].
A 17% drop in crude oil prices over 10 days provides input cost relief to MMF textile units [71350aa24679].
what_to_watch: Post-festive order book status and trade credit terms for textile traders as markets resume full operations.
Working capital utilization and inventory levels of textile traders affected by inflation-driven slowdowns.
Sustained order inflows for diamond units post-Christmas export order fulfillment.
